milestones.label: Application portal opens for non-EU/EEA master's applicants (September 2027 start)
milestones.source_text: The University of Copenhagen important-dates page (official) lists 15 November as the portal opening for non-EU/EEA applicants; the page does not print the year.

milestones.label: Admission decisions sent to non-EU/EEA applicants (no separate scholarship notification date is published)
milestones.time_text: 12 March 2027 (decisions sent on a rolling basis)
milestones.source_text: The university pages (official) say decisions go to non-EU applicants for a September start by 12 March and the place must be accepted by 18 March. They do not say when scholarship nominees are told.
